children: Australia's corporate regulator is examining 551 whistleblower and misconduct complaints at the country's big four auditing firms, a parliamentary committee hearing was told on Friday.
The Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) will review each complaint before launching an official investigation, its chair, Sarah Court, told a Sydney hearing.
The big four auditing firms are KPMG, PwC, Deloitte and EY.
The parliamentary committee is scrutinising KPMG Australia, which has been accused of misusing confidential client information to bid for audit contracts.
